bundleDescription: Generate a ZIP containing recent logs for support and troubleshooting
languageDescription: Choose the translation language. Missing entries fall back to EN, then zh-CN, then the key or ID.
openLogDir: Open the folder containing the application logs
skillIdDisplayDescription: Control how IDs are shown in skill tables.
showHoverDescriptionsDescription: Show generated descriptions in hover text for skills, buffs, modifiers, modules, and other UID-backed rows when available.
title: Debug
translationRefreshDescription: Reload runtime translation data and notify the frontend.
translationSourceModeDescription: Switch between the app's built-in translations and the editable translation files stored in AppData.
globalDebugInfoBody: Use this page for logs, diagnostics bundles, translation runtime tools, and developer-facing display helpers. These tools affect the app globally and are no longer nested under Meter Settings.
bundleCreatedCopied: Diagnostics bundle created and path copied:
cleanupDescription: Delete old debug bundles and app-data Event Logger session files. This does not delete profiles, settings, or saved encounters.
factorTraceDescription: Opt-in capture for factor energy bugs. Start it, reproduce for 30-60 seconds, stop it, then export JSON. This is separate from diagnostics bundles.
factorTraceExportedCopied: Factor trace exported and path copied:
